items.q: How does the free trial work?
items.a: The free trial gives you full access to the Standard plan for 14 days. No credit card is required.

items.q: What do you look for in a founding team?
items.a: We look for complementary skills, proven delivery and a clear understanding of the contracting market.

items.q: Do you recommend Pay as you go or Pre pay?
items.a: Pre pay plans are cheaper per posting, while Pay as you go offers more flexibility for occasional use.

items.q: What do I get for $0 with my plan?
items.a: The Standard plan includes 15 job postings, 7 featured jobs and posts live for 30 days.

items.q: How do I change my password?
items.a: Open Account Settings in your dashboard and use the Change Password form.

items.q: Where can I read the terms?
items.a: Our full terms are available on the Terms & Conditions page linked in the footer.
